# TxID

> TxID is a white-label AI support agent that DeFi protocols and Web3 token projects embed on their site with a single script tag. It auto-detects the user's connected wallet, diagnoses failed on-chain transactions in plain English, answers questions from the protocol's documentation, and escalates to the human team when it can't resolve something. Every answer is recorded with the conditions it was produced under, so it can be verified later.

For the full, self-contained reference (all capabilities, the failed-transaction glossary, FAQ, and pricing in one file), see https://txid.support/llms-full.txt

## What it does

- **Automatic wallet detection**: reads the connected wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, Petra, Martian) with no signing or permission prompt: it only reads public on-chain data. Users can also paste an address without connecting anything.
- **Transaction diagnostics**: pastes or detects a transaction and explains why it failed: out of gas, `require` revert reasons, custom Solidity errors, panics (arithmetic overflow/underflow, division by zero, array out of bounds), generic reverts, and Move abort codes on Aptos decoded against framework and protocol error maps.
- **On-chain lookups**: wallet balance, recent transaction history, token approvals, contract state, and a specific transaction's details.
- **Sub accounts**: on protocols that hold user funds in a per-user account object rather than the wallet, such as a perps or margin venue, TxID resolves that account on connect and shows both addresses labelled, so a trader never meets an unexplained second address.
- **Docs Q&A**: answers grounded in the protocol's own documentation and knowledge base using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), not hallucinated.
- **The case record**: every answer is stored with the ledger version it was true as of, the prices any figure rested on, which lookups ran and which failed, the model, and a hash of the answer. Records are append-only, enforced in the database, and exportable.
- **Escalation**: opens a human support ticket when the AI can't resolve an issue, and delivers it to Slack, Discord, Telegram, Linear, GitHub or Jira. Failed deliveries are retried rather than lost.
- **Channels**: embeddable web widget, an optional Telegram bot using the same knowledge, a React component, and a REST API.

## Chains supported

Live: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, Etherlink, and Aptos.

Aptos is Move-native rather than another EVM chain: TxID reads it through Aptos's own fullnode REST and Indexer GraphQL, and decodes Move aborts into plain English.

Solana, Stellar and TON are not live yet.

## Who it's for

DeFi protocols, token projects, and Web3 teams that get repetitive support questions ("why did my transaction fail?", "where are my tokens?", "how does staking work?") and want to answer them automatically instead of staffing a support team. Teams that have to show their work later, to an auditor, a regulator or a user in dispute, use the case record for it.

## How to install

Add one script tag before the closing `</body>` tag. No SDK, no build step. Works with React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, or plain HTML.

## Pricing

- **Evaluation**: 150 conversations per month to prove TxID on your own protocol. Wallet detection, transaction diagnostics, docs Q&A, custom branding, and the analytics dashboard.
- **Enterprise**: for protocols running the agent in production, priced to the platform. Higher volume, every supported chain, escalation integrations, the full case record and export, and priority support.

## Articles

- [Transaction error messages explained](https://txid.support/blog/transaction-error-messages-explained): a plain-English key to every failure message (intrinsic gas too low, execution reverted, nonce too low, insufficient allowance, custom errors, panics) and how to fix each.
- [Recording AI support conversations: what compliance requires](https://txid.support/blog/recording-ai-support-conversations-compliance): what a defensible record of an AI chat needs, and how TxID keeps one.
- [Why did my transaction fail? Every revert reason explained](https://txid.support/blog/why-did-my-transaction-fail): out of gas, reverts, custom errors, panics, slippage, allowance.
- [What does "out of gas" mean in crypto?](https://txid.support/blog/what-does-out-of-gas-mean): why it happens and how to fix it.
- [What is agentic support?](https://txid.support/blog/what-is-agentic-support): how AI agents that investigate differ from chatbots that answer.
- [How to evaluate an AI support tool for your protocol](https://txid.support/blog/how-to-evaluate-ai-support-for-defi): a buyer's checklist.
- [Wallet-aware support vs generic chatbots](https://txid.support/blog/wallet-aware-support-vs-generic-chatbots): what changes when the assistant can read the connected wallet.
- [What on-chain data should your support bot read?](https://txid.support/blog/on-chain-data-support-bot): the four data sources that matter.
- [How to set up docs Q&A for your DeFi protocol](https://txid.support/blog/docs-qa-defi-protocol): crawling, chunking and retrieval.
- [How to reduce DeFi support tickets by 60%](https://txid.support/blog/reduce-defi-support-tickets): deflect at source, not at the queue.
- [Why your Discord support is a scam vector](https://txid.support/blog/defi-discord-support-scam-vector): and how in-app support closes it.
- [Why your Telegram community needs on-chain AI support](https://txid.support/blog/telegram-community-support): answering in the open, with wallet context.

## Documentation pages

- [Introduction](https://txid.support/docs/introduction) and [Quick start](https://txid.support/docs/quick-start): the concepts and the fastest path to live.
- [Connecting the user's wallet](https://txid.support/docs/connect-wallet): pass the connected wallet from your app with window.txid.identify(), so users never connect twice.
- [Transaction diagnosis: on or off](https://txid.support/docs/modes): run the full diagnostician, or a docs-only assistant that never touches a transaction.
- [Bug reports & feedback](https://txid.support/docs/bug-reports): collect both from testers in the widget, with a case record on each.
- [Team & access](https://txid.support/docs/roles): Admin, Developer, Support and Auditor roles.
- [Records & compliance](https://txid.support/docs/records): what is stored behind every answer, and how it stays append-only.
- [Smart contracts](https://txid.support/docs/smart-contracts), [Knowledge base](https://txid.support/docs/knowledge-base) and [Chains](https://txid.support/docs/chains): configuration.
- [Embed & go live](https://txid.support/docs/embed) and [Analytics](https://txid.support/docs/analytics): shipping and measuring.
